 RAXXY TAKES OVER PITTI UOMO 111 AS SPECIAL GUEST, BRINGING SCULPTURAL OUTERWEAR INTO A NEW DIMENSION 
 Vanity Teen 
 Florence, January 12–15, 2027 – Fashion meets the future as RAXXY lands at Pitti Uomo 111 as its Special Guest , bringing a radical vision of luxury outerwear to the heart of Florence.
 Founded in 2020 by William Shen , the brand is set to transform the Sala della Scherma into an immersive experience where mathematics, geometry, architecture and sculpture collide. Forget the puffer as you know it: at RAXXY, down jackets become wearable sculptures, pushing volume, structure and material experimentation into unexpected territory.
 Behind this unconventional universe is Shen himself, a former Mathematics Olympiad silver medalist turned self-taught designer, whose approach brings scientific precision into fashion’s creative playground. From Colour Sculpture to the pioneering 5D Down Jacket and a patented 3D block-structure system, his work challenges the very idea of what outerwear can be.
 At the intersection of heritage, technology, art and craftsmanship, RAXXY is building its own visual language; one where AI algorithms and patented innovations meet a distinctly futuristic aesthetic.
 Not just outerwear. Not just fashion. A new dimension of wearable architecture.
